methods.name: Sea charting
methods.note: One-off tasks from the captain's log: 358 in all, worth 691,270 XP. Prying Times at 12 and Current Affairs at 22 add tools. Completing every task needs 78 Sailing.

methods.name: Courier tasks between early ports
methods.note: Port Sarim to The Pandemonium pays 78 XP one way or 155 as a round trip. Musa Point opens at 10. Two tasks at once from 7, three from 28. Chart seas on the way.

methods.name: Shipwreck salvaging with one hook
methods.note: Skiff with one hook and a cargo hold. Wrecks at 15, 26, 35 and 53; hooks at 21, 27 and 44, fitted by a shipwright for a fee. Sorting at sea from 42 needs 34 Construction.

methods.name: The Tempor Tantrum
methods.note: First Barracuda Trial, skiff only. A shipwright fits the iron helm (1,400 coins) and oak mast (920) from your materials; ironmen weave the linen at 12 Crafting.

methods.name: Courier tasks Summer Shore route
methods.note: Take Musa Point, Port Sarim or Pandemonium tasks at The Summer Shore, 2,001 to 2,616 XP each, and sail them back. About nine trips an hour; boat recovery costs coins.

methods.name: Shipwreck salvaging with two hooks
methods.note: Sloop: you work one hook, a crewmate the other, sorting at sea. Crew on both hooks gives under half. Mercenary wrecks (73) need an adamant helm, Fremennik (80) a brazier.

methods.name: The Jubbly Jive
methods.note: Second Barracuda Trial. A shipwright fits the mithril helm for 50,000 coins; the inoculation station needs Relicym's balm. Marlin rank with a teak or mahogany hull.

methods.name: Deep sea trawling
methods.note: Sloop on giant krill shoals, you on one net and a crewmate on the other; trains Fishing too. Sailing XP a roll: rope 7, linen (65) 9, hemp (76) 11, cotton (84) 15.

methods.name: Courier tasks Rellekka route
methods.req: q:The Fremennik Trials|Children of the Sun;s:magic 56,construction 49
methods.note: Take Rellekka tasks, teleport to Aldarin, cast Summon Boat (needs a teleport focus on the boat) and deliver north. Etceteria adds tasks at 65 with Royal Trouble.

methods.name: Courier tasks Prifddinas route
methods.req: q:Song of the Elves|Children of the Sun;s:construction 62,magic 56
methods.note: Tasks from Prifddinas, Port Tyras, Deepfin Point and Aldarin: cast Summon Boat at Aldarin and deliver back. Tirannwn's waters need an adamant keel. Board dependent.

methods.name: The Gwenith Glide
methods.note: Third Barracuda Trial, the fastest Sailing XP. Needs an adamant keel (ironmen smith its parts at 74) and a wind catcher. Marlin at its 6:09 target; extractor from 73.

methods.name: Courier tasks Lunar Isle route
methods.note: Stack round trips to Lunar Isle from Aldarin, Deepfin Point and Civitas illa Fortis, using Summon Boat. You can dock from 76; the rate is for five task slots at 84.

unverified: All Sailing methods: the Sailing training page still carries the Obsolete banner (revision of 4 October 2026); TempleOSRS has no Sailing rates table and Wise Old Man gives mains and ironmen the same Sailing rates, so there is one ceiling to check against, not two; the Ironman Guide still states no hourly rates

Sea charting: 10,000 an hour at level 22 is the guide's only figure and equals the Wise Old Man rate for port tasks, charting and quests together below level 30; no rate exists below 22 (first band 0); charting is one-off XP (691,270 in all), so the rate cannot run to 99

Courier tasks between early ports: 3,000 an hour is derived, not measured (78 XP for a one-way Port Sarim to Pandemonium task, about 214 tiles at 1.5 tiles a tick plus loading, about 32 legs an hour, plus sail trimming); two task slots from level 7 can raise it and no tested rate has been published; this fills the level 1 to 14 stretch the tests pin as unrated

Shipwreck salvaging with one hook: the guide's one-hook figures date from before the 3 December 2025 success-rate increase (11 to 16%); up to 35 they are kept because the money making guides (sorting at a port: 2,170 at 15, about 4,360 at 27, 10,230 at 35) and a model built from the wreck pages' success values (dropping the salvage: 3,060, 6,000, 10,950) sit either side of them, and the Small shipwreck page says about 1,600 at 15; 14,500 at 44 and 22,000 at 53 are derived (guide figure raised by the stated increase, checked against the model) and nobody has published a one-hook test since

Shipwreck salvaging with two hooks: the bands at 53, 59, 80 and 87 are guide ranges measured after December 2025 and sit within 10% of the model; 50, 64 and 73 are derived because those guide cells predate the December 2025 changes (the guide's 44,000 to 47,000 for pirate wrecks with adamant hooks is one, against its own later mithril figure of 35,000 to 38,000); the rates assume adamant hooks at 59 (Construction 52) and rune at 74 (Construction 66), an adamant helm for mercenary wrecks (Construction 59) and an eternal brazier for Fremennik wrecks (Construction 72), which req cannot state band by band; with crew on both hooks Jagex measured 35,000 to 40,000 an hour at 97, against 85,000 with the player on a hook, and the money making guides, which have crew pull half to two thirds of the salvage, give 17,900 at large wrecks, 26,800 at pirate, 49,300 at mercenary, 51,700 at Fremennik and 60,200 at merchant; tick manipulation is left out; the 74 band (67,500) is a guide cell from before the December 2025 changes and has not been retested

The Tempor Tantrum: the guide's formula (1,907 XP per 270 s target plus 10 s) gives 24,519; the trial page gives 1,790 XP a lap and 23,800 an hour and Wise Old Man 25,000; the 4:30 target may be out of reach at level 30 before a teak hull at 31; a shipwright's fee covers the build but not the materials, so an ironman needs 12 Crafting for five bolts of linen, which req cannot state for one account type only

The Jubbly Jive: 85,000 is the trial page's figure for a teak or mahogany hull (written in November 2025; the trial's XP has not changed since) and equals the Wise Old Man rate, so ordinary play may be a little lower; the guide's formula gives 88,923 using the trim XP of sails that need 68 Sailing; ironmen need part of Zogre Flesh Eaters to make Relicym's balm, which req cannot express; 37 Construction for the station is boostable

The Gwenith Glide: the guide's formula (19,410 XP per 369 s target plus 10 s) gives 184,369 and its 73 band adds 13,750 for the crystal extractor, which needs 67 Construction and the trial's Shark rank; the trial page's own hourly cell (177,170) still uses the old 14,800 completion XP; a wind catcher (Jubbly Jive Shark rank, 47 Construction) is needed to make the times and ironmen need 74 Smithing for keel parts, neither of which req can express; a rosewood hull at 93 (Construction 84) lifts it to 200,000 or more and is not banded

Courier tasks Summer Shore, Rellekka, Prifddinas and Lunar Isle routes: the guide still calls these rough estimates extrapolated from tests made before courier XP rose 10% on 3 June 2026 and not retested; the task XP list was re-based after the rise and checked against 80 tasks in game, but no route has a published post-rise test, and notice boards only refresh after eight completed tasks

Courier tasks Summer Shore route: the guide said 33,000 until 30 August 2026, when one editor cut it to 20,000 citing a round-trip nerf that no official post records; 20,000 fits one 2,001 to 2,616 XP task a trip at about nine trips an hour

Courier tasks Rellekka route: 66,000 is the guide's rough estimate with only Rellekka unlocked and has not been retested; its 99,000 from 65 is for favourable routes with Etceteria and beats the Wise Old Man rate of 85,000 at that level, so no band is given for it; the route is written around Summon Boat (56 Magic, a teleport focus needing 49 Construction and a magic stone), and paying a shipwright to recover the boat each lap is the costly alternative

Courier tasks Lunar Isle route: the guide's 130,000 to 160,000 is for five task slots at 84 (it read 120,000 to 145,000 for 84 before courier XP rose 10%) and varies with crystal extractor use, so the entry starts at 84 on the bottom of the range; the route can be sailed from 76 with four slots, but its largest task (Aldarin to Lunar Isle, 12,671 XP) needs 80 and nobody has published a rate for 76 to 83; the guide's version also calls at Prifddinas (Song of the Elves, adamant keel), which req leaves out

Deep sea trawling: no post-change test exists for rope or hemp nets, so those bands are derived: 2,000 rolls an hour for the player's net and 1,200 for a crewmate's, at the XP a roll each net gives, with the crewmate at 70% of it (the page's figure for deckhandiness 4; lower deckhandiness is not published, and rope uses 50%) and 85% of the hour on the shoal; that model gives 21,700 for linen against tests of 21,000 to 23,500 on haddock and halibut shoals but 16,000 on krill, and 42,600 for cotton against tests of 43,000 and 44,000; the guide's 7,000 to 10,000 for rope predates the 20 May 2026 change; nets need Construction 45, 61, 65 and 73, which req cannot state band by band

Courier tasks Prifddinas route: 74,000 is the middle of the guide's 71,000 to 77,000, a rough estimate not retested since courier XP rose; Port Tyras and the waters off Prifddinas need an adamant keel (66 Sailing, 62 Construction), and an ironman also needs 74 Smithing for its parts
Bounty tasks, tick-manipulated salvaging and the crystal extractor (13,250 an hour on top of any method from 73) are described on the wiki without a usable hourly rate and are not listed as methods
Quests: Pandemonium gives 100 more Sailing XP when the cargo is delivered (400 in all) and the list has 300; The Graveyard (65 Sailing, 35,000 Sailing XP proposed) is not in the game yet
